releaseNotes:
Feature: Midnight Blue UI across the whole app — new buttons, tabs, inputs, checkboxes, trees, scrollbars, modals and status badges, plus stroke icons everywhere
Feature: Every button now has a Persian tooltip that explains what it does
Feature: Backup Scheduler wizard redesigned — icon step headers, titled sections, Next-runs timeline, clearer warnings and themed inputs
Feature: Deploy, Direct Upload and Remote/FTP panels restyled (branch chips with ahead/behind counters, file rows with type icons and badges, mapping banner, size column)
Site: New website with real screenshots of the app
Fix: Theme manager removed — the app now has one fixed, consistent look
